thread:
Anna Chen: Heads up — customer reported an unexpected token delta after a streaming reconnect where the client retried and a tool call got truncated mid-swap. Billing shows ~120 extra tokens. Anyone seen this pattern? @sasha

Sasha Ilyin: yup saw something similar in canary earlier. looks like ledger marks provisional tokens for both pre-swap and post-swap prefix. :confused:

Mike Roberts: do we have trace ids? need to confirm whether reconnect caused double-marking or a suffix capture bug.

Anna Chen: pasted a minimal router log to illustrate:
{"trace_id":"t-4bf3","event":"resume","route":"micro-swap","shard":"s-12","tool_call":{"id":"tc-99","state":"truncated","tokens":55}}

Note: router emitted provisional on handoff, then final commit from new shard captured trailing tokens.

Sasha Ilyin: I think the switch happens because session_key gets regenerated on micro-swap. provisional uses old session_key while final commit uses new session id, so dedupe by session_key fails.

Emily (billing): if both provisional and final are marked confirmed we double count. quick mitigation: dedupe final commits by tool_call.id if a provisional exists from the last 60s.

Mike Roberts: fine for a quick canary. also add telemetry metric toolcall_double_confirm with labels {workspace, model_variant, router_shard} so we can quantify impact.

deploy-bot: canary rollout queued for eng-platform-canary in 20m — tag dedupe-guard-60s.

Sasha Ilyin: created a tiny PR with the guard + unit tests for resume+swap path. will watch canary and post results here.

Anna Chen: thanks all. follow-up items: add console alert rule when >5 double-confirms/hour per workspace, and a dashboard card for the new metric. ping me if you want to pair on the telemetry dash. :thumbsup:
